claims: The last day to file 2025 federal income tax returns is Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
Electronic returns must be submitted by midnight in your time zone on April 15, 2026.
Paper returns must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.
Payment is due on April 15, 2026 if you owe taxes, regardless of an extension.
Filing Form 4868 by April 15, 2026 grants an automatic extension until October 15, 2026 to file the return.
The automatic extension from Form 4868 does not delay payment obligations.
The IRS Free File program can be used to prepare and e-file returns.
H&R Block can be used to prepare and e-file returns.
Late filing penalties can reach 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
Free assistance is available through VITA/TCE/AARP Tax-Aide sites.
The deadline to file 2025 federal income tax returns for those living outside the United States and Puerto Rico is June 15, 2026.
